page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening); running head at top, one main text column, a bracketed marginal label "Pæna" with Suspensio / Excommunicatio beside the text as a small two-line block within the column; a short note at the foot of the text. page.running_head: Lib.5. De speciali. in politeia diuina.

main_text.l: lem iniueantur & sentiant. Prou.5.12. 1. Cor. 14. 2.
3.4. 5. In interna dispositione cum actione con-
iuncta, est ex priore ad cor confractum & contri-
tum adduci.2.Cor.3.4.5.6.7.8. Fructus perceptio est ut
ex sensu illo ad resipiscentiam, coram multis
vel omnibus, lachrymarum, obtestationum, suspi-
ciorum ardentibus desiderijs, absolutionem peten-
tibus ratam faciant. 1.Cor.5.5. 2.Cor.2.3.4.5.6.
Pæna est Suspensio. Excomunicatio. Num.9.10.13. Luc.
Suspensio,est pæna inflicta, quæ ἀφορισμῷ à
sacris quibusdam, siue communibus, siue administrarum
proprijs,ad tempus constitutum versatur.Gen.42.3:
28. Quare cum his hac nota designatis commercia ne
habeantur ut eos pudeat; ut fratres tamen monendi
sunt.2.Thes.3.14.
Excomunicatio est pæna inflicta,quæ versetur in ab-
soluta separatione à communione bonorum & illorum
priuilegijs.Gen.
Math.18.17. 1.Cor 5.5.13. Quare cum his etiam ne
commedamus prohibemur.1.Cor.5.11.
Anathematis censura,est pæna tantum peccanti in
spirit.sanct.debita: qua quispiam absq; omni spe in
æternum exitiu devouetur.Ge.4.14. Mal.3.v/t. 1.Cor.

l.i: Atq; hæc de censuris & omnibus rebus Iehouæ post
Hactenus de Domino: Sequitur de administris.

page.notes: Page is a right-hand page; the marginal letters at the left edge belong to the facing page. The marginal "Pæna" bracket block is set within the column and is transcribed in place. Greek word ἀφορισμῷ is approximate. Several Latin words in the scan are blurred and uncertain (e.g. "Quare", "versatur"); reading is best effort.
